title: Cross-scale organisation of the atmospheric circulation: a falsification-grade research programme (Shroedinger, gen4)
description:
v6.3 — paper 2 of the series: journal-format manuscript and a single reproduction script. Numerical results of all frozen experiments are identical to v6.0.

  • manuscript_v2/article2/article2_v4.pdf (source article2_v4_src.tex) — paper 2, “Geography of the coupling between hierarchical levels of the atmospheric circulation: a planetary map, its controls and a regionalisation” (in Russian, journal format): the planetary map of scale coupling on 936 cells, its provinces, latitudinal structure, land–ocean and seasonal contrasts, the controls of its geography, the unexplained part, reproduction by a free-running model, and a typology of territories proposed as a regionalisation layer.
  • reproducibility/reproduce_article2.py — the single entry point for paper 2 (--stage download | compute | figures | manuscript | check | all): 9 resumable downloaders, 20 computation steps, the descriptive layer, Russian-label 300-dpi figures, the journal-format manuscript build, and a check of 16 artifacts against SHA-256; route per table and figure in reproducibility/article2_README.md.
  • New code: describe_B20_geography.py (descriptive layer with a gazetteer tying every place name to a cell id), visualize_article2_ru.py, verify_article2_descriptives.py (D1–D4), Phase 25 (hydroclimatic candidates for the unexplained part of the map — NEGATIVE by the frozen ladder; vertical wind shear named as the single candidate).
  • manuscript_v2/ is reorganised into article1/, article2/, article3/; paper 1 submission package with 300-dpi figures.
  • Phase 26 (coupling map vs the geography of precipitation extremes): protocol frozen and code committed; verdict pending, not part of paper 2.

Raw ERA5 / MERRA-2 / HighResMIP fields are deliberately not stored; the exact download scripts and all derived tables are included. Author rules of the target journal are referenced, not redistributed (docs/journal/README.md).
notes: Supersedes release v6.2. Adds paper 2 (journal-format manuscript v4), its single reproduction script, the descriptive layer and Phase 25; repository manuscripts reorganised per article. Frozen numerical results unchanged since v6.0.
